name: AstaBrief_8B_SFT
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-8B (config.json max_position_embeddings 40960). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A finetune of Qwen/Qwen3-8B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 8.19 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-10. CAVEATS: ScholarQA-CS2 is Allen AI's own literature-synthesis benchmark, so this is a same-lab evaluation. Answer Precision 90.4 vs 90.6 is the single regression. 5 epochs, LR 5e-6, 32k context, BF16.
